moderation.action.category.defaultMessage: {category, select, spam {垃圾信息} legal {法律原因} violation {违反服务器规则} other {其他}}
moderation.action.category.description: Label of the reason category that a moderator chose for an action on the user's own account. {category} is the category.

moderation.action.kind.defaultMessage: {kind, select, warn {警告} mark_statuses_sensitive {帖子已标记为敏感内容} delete_statuses {帖子已删除} force_sensitive {媒体始终标记为敏感内容} limit {已限制：帖子仅向关注者显示，且不出现在公开时间线中} restrict_posting {禁止发帖、回复、转发和编辑} restrict_interaction {禁止关注、喜欢、转发和回复} disable_login {已禁止登录} suspend {已封禁：无法使用应用，个人资料和帖子已隐藏} ban {已永久封禁：账号已删除} other {审核操作}}
moderation.action.kind.description: Label of the kind of a moderation action on the user's own account, in the notice of the action and the list of the user's actions. {kind} is the kind; the label must make sense whether or not the action is still in effect.
